questions.prompt_html: \int x ^ { 2 } \ln x d x \text { 的值为[ ]}

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{x^{3}}{3}\ln x-\frac{x^{3}}{3}+C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\ \ \text{令}u=\ln x,\ dv=x^{2}dx,\ \text{则}du=\frac{1}{x}dx,\ v=\frac{1}{3}x^{3},\ \text{于是,}\\&\int x^{2}\ln xdx=\int \ln x d\frac{x^{3}}{3}=\frac{x^{3}}{3}\ln x-\int \frac{x^{3}}{3}d\ln x=\frac{x^{3}}{3}\ln x-\int \frac{x^{3}}{3}\cdot \frac{1}{x}dx\\&=\frac{x^{3}}{3}\ln x-\frac{1}{3}\int x^{2}dx=\frac{x^{3}}{3}\ln x-\frac{x^{3}}{9}+C.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \int e ^ { x } \sin x d x \text { 的值为[ ]}

options.label: A
options.html: \frac { e ^ { x } } { 2 } ( \sin x - \cos x ) + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{e^{x}}{2}(\sin x + \cos x) + C

options.label: C
options.html: e^{x}(\sin x - \cos x) + C

options.label: D
options.html: e^{x}(\sin x + \cos x) + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\ \ \int e^{x}\sin x\,dx=\int \sin x\,de^{x}=e^{x}\sin x-\int e^{x}d(\sin x)\\&=e^{x}\sin x-\int e^{x}\cos x\,dx=e^{x}\sin x-(e^{x}\cos x-\int e^{x}d\cos x)\\&=e^{x}(\sin x-\cos x)-\int e^{x}\sin x\,dx\,,\\&\text{于是}\int e^{x}\sin x\,dx=\frac{e^{x}}{2}(\sin x-\cos x)+C\,.\end{aligned}

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.html: \sqrt { 1 + x ^ { 2 } } \ln x + \ln { \frac { \sqrt { 1 + x ^ { 2 } } - 1 } { x } } + C

options.label: D
options.html: \sqrt { 1 + x ^ { 2 } } - \ln { \frac { \sqrt { 1 + x ^ { 2 } } - 1 } { x } } + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答注意到} \\&(\sqrt{1+x^2})'=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}\ ,\ \text{故知}I=\int \ln x d\sqrt{1+x^2}=\sqrt{1+x^2}\ln x-\int \frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}}{x}dx\,.\\&\text{对上式右端第二个积分，做变换}x=\tan t\ ,\text{则有} \\&\int \frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}}{x}dx=\int \frac{dt}{\sin t \cos^2 t}=-\int \frac{d\cos t}{\sin^2 t \cos^2 t}\ \xlongequal{}\frac{u=\cos t}{u^2(1-u^2)}-\int \frac{du}{u^2(1-u^2)}=-\int (\frac{1}{u^2}+\frac{1}{1-u^2})du\\&=\frac{1}{u}-\frac{1}{2}\ln \left|\frac{1+u}{1-u}\right|+C=\frac{1}{\cos t}-\frac{1}{2}\ln \left|\frac{1+\cos t}{1-\cos t}\right|+C=\sqrt{1+x^2}+\ln \frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}-1}{x}+C\\&\text{从而我们有}I=\sqrt{1+x^2}(\ln x-1)-\ln \frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}-1}{x}+C\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \ \int \frac{ \arctan x } { x ^ { 2 } ( 1 + x ^ { 2 } ) } d x \text{ 的值为 } [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}-\frac{2}{x}\arctan x + \ln |x| - [ \ln (1 + x^2) + \arctan^2 x ] + C \; ,\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{x}\arctan x+\ln|x|-2[\ln(1+x^{2})+\arctan^{2}x]+C

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{array}{l} {l} - \frac { 1 } { x } \arctan x + \ln | x | - \frac { 1 } { 2 } [ \ln ( 1 + x ^ { 2 } ) + \arctan ^ { 2 } x ] + C \end{array}

options.label: D
options.html: -{\frac{2}{x}}\arctan x+\ln|x|-{\frac{1}{2}}[\ln(1+x^{2})+\arctan^{2}x]+C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答 根据分部积分，我们有}\\&\text{原式}=\int\left(\frac{1}{x^{2}}-\frac{1}{1+x^{2}}\right)\arctan xdx\\&=\int\frac{1}{x^{2}}\arctan xdx-\int\arctan xd\arctan x\\&=\int\arctan xd\left(-\frac{1}{x}\right)-\frac{1}{2}\arctan^{2}x\\&=-\frac{1}{x}\arctan x+\int\frac{dx}{x(1+x^{2})}-\frac{1}{2}\arctan^{2}x\\&=-\frac{1}{x}\arctan x+\int\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x}{1+x^{2}}\right)dx-\frac{1}{2}\arctan^{2}x\\&=-\frac{1}{x}\arctan x+\ln|x|-\frac{1}{2}[\ln(1+x^{2})+\arctan^{2}x]+C.\end{aligned}
